name: Willow Springs Event Center
description: A bright white reception venue with indoor and outdoor areas, chandeliers, a covered heated patio, lawn space, a pergola, a full kitchen, and a private bridal suite with bathroom.

items.label: Description
items.value: A bright white reception venue with indoor and outdoor areas, chandeliers, a covered heated patio, lawn space, a pergola, a full kitchen, and a private bridal suite with bathroom.

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
7-hour rental, 3pm-10pm (entire indoor/outdoor venue, full kitchen, bridal suite, tables, chairs, initial table and chair setup, sound system, TVs, projector, wireless microphone, café lights, patio enclosure, heaters and fans) — Nov-Mar Mon-Wed — $1,199
Same inclusions — Nov-Mar Thu — $1,499
Same inclusions — Nov-Mar Fri-Sat and holidays — $1,799
Same inclusions — Apr-Oct Mon-Wed — $1,749
Same inclusions — Apr-Oct Thu — $1,999
Same inclusions — Apr-Oct Fri-Sat and holidays — $2,499
Basic decoration package — $325
Ceremony decoration package — $225
Linens — $16.25
Additional hour (up to midnight) — $295/hour

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
Deposit is half the venue cost
Non-refundable but transferable to another available date

items.label: Outdoors
items.value: Lawn with string lights, seating and lawn games

items.label: Ballroom
items.value: Setting: indoor · Notes: four chandeliers, fireplace, 30-ft sliding glass doors

items.label: Lawn with café lights and pergola
Included items
items.value:
150 chairs
16 round tables (60 in.)
4 8-ft and 14 6-ft banquet tables
7 bistro tables
Four chandeliers
Fireplace with mantle
Covered patio with enclosure, heaters, fans and lighting
Café lights over the lawn and send-off area
Pergola with string lights
Large lawn
Basketball court
Wifi

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Indoor and outdoor speaker systems
Wireless microphone and stand
Projector and screen
2 indoor TVs and 1 outdoor TV

items.label: Centerpieces
items.value: Table Centerpieces (5 to choose from) - Quantity: 12

items.label: Greenery / florals
items.value: Lantern, hoop and vase floral pieces

items.label: Candles / lanterns
items.value: Wreath and wood lanterns with flameless candles

items.label: String / bistro lights
items.value: Cafe lights; pergola with string lights

items.label: For rent
items.value:
Basic decoration package (12 table centerpieces with wreaths, lanterns, greenery, flameless candles or flowers; mantle and entry table decor; 2 A-frame chalkboards; 9 easels; welcome sign) — $325
Ceremony decoration package (arch/backdrop, 16 aisle enders) — $225
Aisle-ender chair ties — $4.25 per chair
Linens (floor-length base linens, overlays, runners, chair ties, napkins) — $16.25

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Thirty-foot sliding glass doors to the patio
Customizable lighting
Lawn games and room for a bounce house

items.label: Basic Decoration Package
items.value: Price: $325 · Includes: 12 table centerpieces (5 styles); fireplace mantle decorations; entry table decorations; 2 A-frame chalkboards; 9 easels; welcome sign

items.label: Ceremony Decoration Package
items.value: Price: $225 · Includes: arch/backdrop (4 styles); 16 ceremony aisle enders · Add ons: aisle-ender chair ties $4.25 per chair

items.label: Linens
items.value: Price: $16.25 · Includes: floor-length base linens, overlays, runners, chair ties, napkins (third-party vendor)

items.label: Catering
items.value: Open vendor policy: no preferred vendors required, so any caterer may be used

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value: Full kitchen with 2 ovens, stove top, ice machine, fridge and microwave

items.label: Times
items.value:
Nov-Mar Mon-Wed 3pm-10pm
Nov-Mar Thu 3pm-10pm
Nov-Mar Fri-Sat and holidays 3pm-10pm
Apr-Oct Mon-Wed 3pm-10pm
Apr-Oct Thu 3pm-10pm
Apr-Oct Fri-Sat and holidays 3pm-10pm

items.label: Rental length
items.value: 7 hours (3pm-10pm); additional hours $295/hour, up to midnight

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Booking pages say décor packages start at $395, but the pricing page lists $325 and $225 packages
Booking pages list a contact address of 554 West Spring Creek Place; the venue address on every page is 554 West 1200 North
